newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Troops of operation "Jaya Sikuru" advance five kilometres into rebel territory, military sources say. The military launched a massive offensive into the rebel-held Wanni region on Tuesday.
New thermal plant to add 115 megawatts of power to national grid from end May, says Minister of Power and Energy, Anuruddha Ratwatte.
Military launches long-awaited push from Vavunia to reopen main supply rout to northern Jaffna peninsula.
Operation Jaya Sikuru launched on Tuesday to open supply route to Jaffna.

Boradcasting Authority Bill to be ammended and reintroduced in parliament, says media minister. The Supreme Court ruled the bill 'unconstitutional' last week, after media organisations filed action against it. The bill proposed setting up an authority with members appointed by the government, to regulate electronic media.
A 115 megawatt thermal power plant, the largest so far in the country, becomes operational on May 28, official sources say.
Operation "Jaya Sikuru" launched from Vavunia on Tuesday.
